notes.title: Huge content update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42882469/ff2bf33997f282ebfffd2100d40d795b3b82403e.jpg[/img]

Now weighing in at over 13000 lines of dialogue from 30000 lines of code, this has become a very complicated, and varied game, despite still being quite short. This update includes a very graphical updates, as well as the whole next segment, and victim giving you twice as much information before having to choose your suspect.

We are also launching the Boardgame, which is a reverse murderer mystery!
You can find more about that in-game.
